title: Learning When to Withdraw: Curriculum Coverage and Rule-Specific Failures in Fine-Tuned Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21045v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-using language agents must revise prepared actions when evidence changes or authority is revoked. Selective withdrawal means suspending affected actions, preserving supported work, and resuming only after sufficient repair. We study supervised fine-tuning in NAQD-Env, a synthetic environment with explicit dependencies and a deterministic reference policy. Four LoRA checkpoints of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct compare an original curriculum with an enriched one, the latter under three system-prompt framings with identical views and targets. Three instruction-tuned baselines and all four checkpoints are evaluated under three inference prompts on fresh validation cases, held-out dependency families, and held-out structural combinations. Under the naqd prompt, SFT checkpoints reach decision agreement of 0.77-0.92 and withdrawal recall of 0.46-0.86, versus 0.45-0.63 and at most 0.06 for the baselines. Rule-level diagnostics qualify these gains. Th

translated_title: 学习何时撤回：微调语言智能体中的课程覆盖与规则特定失败
translated_abstract: 使用工具的语言智能体在证据发生变化或权限被撤销时，必须能够修订已准备好的行动。选择性撤回意味着暂停受影响的行动、保留有充分依据的工作，并仅在完成足够修复后才恢复执行。我们在 NAQD-Env 中研究监督微调，这是一个具有显式依赖关系和确定性参考策略的合成环境。我们对 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 的四个 LoRA 检查点进行了实验，比较原始课程与增强课程，后者在三种系统提示框架下使用相同的视图和目标。三个指令微调基线和全部四个检查点在三种推理提示下，针对全新验证案例、留出的依赖族以及留出的结构组合进行评估。在 naqd 提示下，SFT 检查点达到 0.77–0.92 的决策一致率和 0.46–0.86 的撤回召回率，而基线仅分别为 0.45–0.63 和最高 0.06。规则层面的诊断对这些收益进行了限定性分析。（注：摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过在具有显式依赖关系的合成环境 NAQD-Env 中对 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 进行监督微调，显著提升了语言智能体在证据变化或权限撤销时执行“选择性撤回”的能力（决策一致率达 0.77–0.92、撤回召回率达 0.46–0.86，远超基线），并通过规则级诊断揭示了课程覆盖范围与特定规则失败对性能的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that supervised fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct in the synthetic NAQD-Env environment substantially improves tool-using language agents' ability to selectively withdraw prepared actions when evidence changes or authority is revoked (decision agreement 0.77–0.92, withdrawal recall 0.46–0.86, far exceeding baselines), while rule-level diagnostics reveal how curriculum coverage and rule-specific failures qualify these gains.
